About Exponentia.ai

Exponentia.ai is a fast-growing AI-first technology services company, partnering with enterprises to shape and accelerate their journey to AI maturity. With a presence across the US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore, we bring together deep domain knowledge, cloud-scale engineering, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence to help our clients transform into agile, insight-driven organizations.

We are proud partners with global technology leaders such as Databricks, Microsoft, AWS, and Qlik, and have been consistently recognized for innovation, delivery excellence, and trusted advisories.

Awards & Recognitions:

Innovation Partner of the Year – Databricks, 2024
Digital Impact Award, UK – 2024 (TMT Sector)
Rising Star – APJ Databricks Partner Awards 2023
Qlik’s Most Enabled Partner – APAC

With a team of 450+ AI engineers, data scientists, and consultants, we are on a mission to redefine how work is done, by combining human intelligence with AI agents to deliver exponential outcomes.

Learn more: www.exponentia.ai

About the Role:

We are seeking a highly experienced and technically strong Senior Full Stack Developer with deep expertise in Angular and modern enterprise application development. The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of experience building scalable, secure, and high-performance applications across both frontend and backend technologies.

This role requires a hands-on engineering leader who can drive architecture decisions, develop complex enterprise solutions, mentor development teams, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver business-critical applications.

The candidate should demonstrate strong expertise in Angular, TypeScript, API development, microservices, cloud-native applications, and modern DevOps practices while maintaining high engineering standards and delivering exceptional user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade web applications with high scalability and performance.
Build robust frontend architectures using Angular and modern UI engineering practices.
Develop backend services, APIs, and microservices using modern server-side technologies.
Deliver end-to-end feature development from requirement gathering to deployment and production support.
Ensure applications are optimized for performance, security, maintainability, and scalability.

Roles and Responsibilities


Angular Frontend Leadership

Architect complex Angular applications using modular and reusable component-based architecture.
Drive best practices around:
Angular architecture
State management (NgRx/RxJS)
Lazy loading
Reactive programming
Performance optimization
Frontend security
Develop highly responsive and cross-browser compatible user interfaces.
Collaborate with UX/UI teams to implement intuitive and modern user experiences.
Lead Angular version upgrades, frontend modernization, and UI framework improvements.

 

Backend & API Development

Design and develop scalable RESTful APIs and microservices.
Build secure authentication and authorization mechanisms using OAuth2, JWT, and SSO integrations.
Integrate enterprise systems, third-party APIs, and cloud services.
Implement asynchronous processing, event-driven architecture, and distributed systems.
Optimize backend services for reliability, scalability, and performance.

 

Technical Leadership & Architecture

Participate in architecture discussions and technical solution design.
Define coding standards, engineering best practices, and development guidelines.
Conduct code reviews and ensure high-quality, maintainable code delivery.
Mentor and guide junior and mid-level developers.
Troubleshoot critical production issues and perform root cause analysis.

 

Cloud, DevOps & Delivery

Collaborate with DevOps teams for CI/CD pipeline implementation and release management.
Work on containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.
Support cloud-native application deployment across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Ensure application observability, logging, monitoring, and operational excellence.
Contribute to Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and technical estimations.

Top of Form

Bottom of Form

 

Skills and Qualifications

5+ years of hands-on experience in full stack application development.
Proven experience delivering large-scale enterprise applications in Agile environments.
Strong experience leading technical teams and driving complex engineering initiatives.
Experience working across complete software development lifecycle (SDLC).
Excellent problem-solving and analytical thinking skills.
Ability to work independently and drive technical ownership across projects.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with architects, product owners, QA teams, DevOps teams, and business stakeholders.
Strong decision-making ability in high-pressure and fast-paced environments.
Excellent organizational and prioritization skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver within timelines.
Strong focus on innovation, engineering excellence, and continuous improvement.
High level of accountability, ownership, and commitment to quality delivery.
Passion for learning modern technologies and driving technical transformation initiatives.

 

Required Technical Skills

Frontend Expertise (Angular)

Mandatory Skills

Strong expertise in Angular (Angular 10+ preferred).
Deep understanding of:
TypeScript
JavaScript (ES6+)
RxJS
NgRx / State Management
Angular CLI
Reactive Forms
Lazy Loading
Dependency Injection
Component-based architecture
Route Guards & Interceptors
Frontend performance optimization

 

UI Technologies

Strong experience with:
HTML5
CSS3
SCSS/SASS
Bootstrap / Material UI
Responsive web design
Ability to build pixel-perfect and highly responsive user interfaces.

Backend Development Skills

Preferred Backend Technologies

Strong experience in one or more of the following:
Node.js
.NET Core
Java / Spring Boot
Python
Backend Competencies
REST API development
Microservices architecture
API security and authentication
OAuth2 / JWT / SSO integration
API Gateway implementation
Caching strategies
Event-driven architecture
Asynchronous programming

 

Database & Data Management

Strong experience with relational and NoSQL databases:
PostgreSQL
SQL Server
MongoDB
MySQL
Expertise in:
Database design
Query optimization
Stored procedures
Data modeling
Performance tuning

Cloud & DevOps

Hands-on experience with cloud platforms:
AWS
Microsoft Azure
Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

 

 

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with enterprise SaaS platforms.
Exposure to AI-enabled or data-driven applications.
Experience with frontend microservices or micro frontend architecture.
Knowledge of application security and performance engineering.
Relevant cloud or Angular certifications are a plus.

 

Why Join Exponentia.ai?

Innovate with Purpose: Opportunity to create pioneering AI solutions in partnership with leading cloud and data platforms
Shape the Practice: Build a marquee capability from the ground up with full ownership
Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier talent and learn from industry leaders in AI
Global Exposure: Be part of a high-growth firm operating across US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore
Continuous Growth: Access to certifications, tech events, and partner-led innovation labs
Inclusive Culture: A supportive and diverse workplace that values learning, initiative, and ownership

Ready to build the future of AI with us?

Apply now and become a part of a next-gen tech company that’s setting benchmarks in enterprise AI solutions.
